dict.string: Records the road you drive so it can be drawn afterwards. The trace stays on this phone and is never uploaded.
Keeps recording the road with the screen off, so you can put the phone down and drive. The trace stays on this phone and is never uploaded.
Uses the motion sensors to tell how hard the car is cornering, and to notice when a drive starts and ends so you do not have to press anything.
Reads what is playing so the drive can remember it. Nothing is played, changed, or sent anywhere.
